testCases.title: Web wallet from the registry
testCases.summary: The EHR lists the registry's web wallets, opens the one the person picks, and sends the request to it by postMessage.
walletShows: The wallet shows the EHR's origin during consent.
verifierShows: The EHR lists every wallet in the registry, with the phone's own wallet alongside.
The EHR shows each item's status and data.

testCases.title: Native wallet through the Digital Credentials API
testCases.summary: Same as M1, but the person picks the phone's own wallet and the EHR calls navigator.credentials.get.
walletShows: The wallet shows the EHR's origin during consent.
verifierShows: The EHR shows each item's status and data.
testCases.notes: Record the phone, OS version, browser, and wallet app.

testCases.title: Insurance
testCases.summary: Demographics and insurance, as CARIN or US Core coverage, in FHIR JSON or a SMART Health Card.
verifierShows: The EHR shows the member, payer, and plan from the returned Coverage, whichever profile or format the wallet chose.
If the wallet returns a SMART Health Card, the EHR verifies its signature before showing it.

testCases.title: Pre-visit questionnaire, inline
testCases.summary: The PHQ-2, sent inline. The QuestionnaireResponse must name exactly the requested canonical.
walletShows: The wallet renders the inline form.
verifierShows: The EHR shows each answer next to its question.

testCases.title: One item declined
testCases.summary: The person declines one item and shares the rest.

walletStep.text: Decline Immunizations and share everything else.

verifierShows: The EHR shows Immunizations as declined, not as an error, and the rest normally.

testCases.title: Nothing to share
testCases.summary: Every item comes back declined or unavailable.

walletStep.text: Decline every item, or use a wallet whose patient has no insurance on file.

verifierShows: The EHR handles every item declined or unavailable without breaking the page, and the patient can continue without the wallet.

testCases.title: Anything in USCDI, small patient
testCases.summary: A modest record, whatever resource types the wallet holds.
walletShows: The wallet lets the patient choose what to include.
verifierShows: The EHR shows every returned resource, whatever the resource types.

testCases.title: Anything in USCDI, large patient
testCases.summary: A full record with years of history, to test that large responses arrive intact.

walletStep.text: Answer as a patient with a large record.

verifierShows: The EHR shows the whole record.
testCases.notes: On Android, the wallet returns the response with the three-argument `setGetCredentialResponse`, which passes it to the browser as a file ([Platform notes](https://smart-health-checkin.org/spec/platform-notes.html#android)). Record the browser, phone, and wallet version.

testCases.title: Questionnaire by reference only
testCases.summary: The GAD-7 by canonical, with no inline body. The wallet fetches the hosted form.
walletShows: The wallet renders the fetched form, or reports the item unsupported rather than inventing a form.
verifierShows: The EHR shows the answers.

testCases.title: Versioned canonical
testCases.summary: The PHQ-2 with a |1 version suffix, body inline. The QuestionnaireResponse must echo the versioned canonical exactly.
verifierShows: The EHR shows the answers.

testCases.title: Physician-authored form
testCases.summary: The semaglutide check-in form, inline, with conditional items and typed answers.
walletShows: The wallet renders every item type, shows conditional items only when their conditions are met, and accepts typed answers on the pen question.
verifierShows: The EHR shows every answer, including typed pen-trouble answers.

testCases.title: Narrowed family
testCases.summary: US Core profiles narrowed to Observation, for recent labs and vitals.
verifierShows: The EHR shows the Observations.

testCases.title: No selector
testCases.summary: A selection with no profiles or types: whatever the patient thinks is relevant.
walletShows: The wallet lets the patient choose.
verifierShows: The EHR displays whatever arrives.

testCases.title: SMART Health Card
testCases.summary: Immunizations, with a SMART Health Card preferred over FHIR JSON.
verifierShows: The EHR verifies the card's signature and shows its contents.

testCases.title: One artifact, several items
testCases.summary: One Bundle answers two items, and its fulfills lists both.

walletStep.text: Answer Allergies and Medications with one shared Bundle. Most wallets can't be asked to do this.

verifierShows: The EHR attributes the resources to both items without counting them twice.

testCases.title: Cross-device
testCases.summary: A desktop browser shows a QR code, and the phone's wallet answers.

walletStep.text: Scan the QR code the desktop browser shows with the phone, and share everything.

verifierShows: The response arrives in the desktop page.

testCases.title: In-person handoff
testCases.summary: A front-desk QR code or kiosk lands the patient's phone on the EHR's check-in page.

walletStep.text: Open the check-in page on the phone from the front-desk QR code or kiosk, then share everything.

verifierShows: The same as M2, with the handoff shown.

testCases.title: Prefilled form
testCases.summary: The wallet prefills answers from the patient's records and lets the patient edit them.
walletShows: Prefilled answers are visible to the patient before sending.
verifierShows: The EHR shows the answers.

testCases.title: Write back
testCases.summary: The EHR files returned data and answers into the chart after staff review.
verifierShows: Staff can accept or reject each item.

testCases.title: Unknown selector
testCases.summary: An item with an extension selector kind no wallet knows.
